G3602.b:
⟪ὀδυρμός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ὀδύρομαι, to lament), [in LXX : ⟦Jeremiah 31:15|Je 38 (31):15⟧ (⁨תַּמְרוּריִם⁩), II Mac 11:6*;] ⟪lamentation⟫, ⟪mourning⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:18|Mt 2:18⟧(LXX), ⟦2 Corinthians 7:7|II Co 7:7⟧.†

G3607.b:

G3610.b:
⟪οἰκέτης⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< οἰκέω), [in LXX for ⁨עֶבֶד⁩;] ⟪a house-servant⟫: ⟦Luke 16:13|Lk 16:13⟧, ⟦Romans 14:4|Ro 14:4⟧; pl., ⟦Acts 10:7|Ac 10:7⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:18|I Pe 2:18⟧. (In Plat., Hdt., Si 4:30 6:11, the pl. includes all the inmates of the house, the ⟪familia⟫, οἰκετεία..)†
SYN.: v.s. διάκονος.

G3611.b:
⟪οἰκέω⟫, -ῶ
(< οἶκος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨ישׁב⁩;]
⟪(a)⟫ trans., ⟪to inhabit⟫: c. acc., ⟦1 Timothy 6:16|I Ti 6:16⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ intrans., ⟪to dwell⟫: seq. μετά (of married life), ⟦1 Corinthians 7:12|I Co 7:12⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:13|13⟧; metaph., seq. ἐν: ἀγαθόν, ⟦Romans 7:18|Ro 7:18⟧; ἁμαρτία, ⟦Romans 7:20|Ro 7:20⟧; πνεῦμα θεοῦ, ⟦Romans 8:9|Ro 8:9⟧, ⟦Romans 8:11|11⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:16|I Co 3:16⟧ (cf. ἐν-, κατ-, ἒν-κατ-, παρ-, περι-, συν-οικέω).†

G3612.b:
⟪οἴκημα⟫, -τος, τό
(< οἰκέω), [in LXX: ⟦Ezekiel 16:24|Ez 16:24⟧ (⁨גַּב⁩), To 2:4, Wi 13:15*;] ⟪a dwelling⟫. As a euphemism for other definite terms (e.g. brothel. Hdt., ii, 121; cf. ⟦Ezekiel 16:24|Ez 16:24⟧), ⟪a prison⟫ (Thuc., iv, 47 f.): ⟦Acts 12:7|Ac 12:7⟧.†

G3613.b:
** ⟪οἰκητήριον⟫, -ου, τό
(< οἰκητήρ = οἰκήτωρ, an inhabitant), [in LXX: II Mac 11:2, III Mac 2:15*;] ⟪a habitation⟫: ⟦Jude 1:6|Ju 6⟧; trop., ⟦2 Corinthians 5:2|II Co 5:2⟧.†

G3615.b:
*† ⟪οἰκιακός⟫ (in Plut., al., -ειακός), ή, όν
(< οἰκία), = οἰκεῖος, ⟪belonging to the household⟫, ⟪one's own⟫: ⟦Matthew 10:36|Mt 10:36⟧; opp. to οἰκοδεσπότης, ⟦Matthew 10:25|Mt 10:25⟧.†

G3616.b:
⟪οἰκο-δεσποτέω⟫, -ῶ
(< οἰκοδεσπότης), ⟪to rule a household⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 5:14|I Ti 5:14⟧.†

G3617.b:
*† ⟪οἰκο-δεσπότης⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< οἶκος, δεσπότης), ⟪the master of a house⟫, ⟪a householder⟫: ⟦Matthew 10:25|Mt 10:25⟧ ⟦Matthew 13:27|13:27⟧ ⟦Matthew 20:11|20:11⟧ ⟦Matthew 24:43|24:43⟧, ⟦Mark 14:14|Mk 14:14⟧, ⟦Luke 12:39|Lk 12:39⟧ ⟦Luke 13:25|13:25⟧ ⟦Luke 14:21|14:21⟧; ἄνθρωπος οἰ., ⟦Matthew 13:52|Mt 13:52⟧ ⟦Matthew 20:1|20:1⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:33|21:33⟧; pleonast., οἰ. τ. οἰκίας, ⟦Luke 22:11|Lk 22:11⟧ (v. Bl., § 81, 4).†

G3618.b:
⟪οἰκοδομέω⟫, -ῶ
(< οἰκοδόμος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨בּנה⁩;] ⟪to build a house⟫, ⟪to build⟫: absol., ⟦Luke 11:48|Lk 11:48⟧ ⟦Luke 14:30|14:30⟧ ⟦Luke 17:28|17:28⟧; οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, ⟪the builders⟫ (as ⟦Psalms 118:22|Ps 117 (118):22⟧, ⁨הַבּוֹנִים⁩), ⟦Matthew 21:42|Mt 21:42⟧, ⟦Mark 12:10|Mk 12:10⟧, ⟦Luke 20:17|Lk 20:17⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:7|I Pe 2:7⟧(LXX); ἐπ’ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰ., proverb., ⟦Romans 15:20|Ro 15:20⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦Galatians 2:18|Ga 2:18⟧; πύργον, ⟦Matthew 21:33|Mt 21:33⟧, ⟦Mark 12:1|Mk 12:1⟧, ⟦Luke 14:28|Lk 14:28⟧; ἀποθήκας, ⟦Luke 12:18|Lk 12:18⟧; ναόν, ⟦Mark 14:58|Mk 14:58⟧; pass., ⟦John 2:20|Jo 2:20⟧; οἰκία, ⟦Luke 6:48|Lk 6:48⟧; c. acc. rei seq. dat. pers. (cf. ⟦Genesis 8:20|Ge 8:20⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 16:24|Ez 16:24⟧), ⟦Luke 7:5|Lk 7:5⟧, ⟦Acts 7:47|Ac 7:47⟧, ⟦Acts 7:49|49⟧; acc. seq. ἐπί, ⟦Matthew 7:24|Mt 7:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 7:26|26⟧ ⟦Luke 6:49|Lk 6:49⟧; πόλιν ἐπ’ ὄρους, ⟦Luke 4:29|Lk 4:29⟧; of rebuilding, or restoring, ⟦Matthew 23:29|Mt 23:29⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:61|26:61⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:40|27:40⟧, ⟦Mark 15:29|Mk 15:29⟧, ⟦Luke 11:47|Lk 11:47⟧. Metaph., τ. ἐκκλησίαν, ⟦Matthew 16:18|Mt 16:18⟧; of the growth of Christian character (cf. ⁨בּנה⁩, in ⟦Psalms 28:5|Ps 27 (28):5⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 24:6|Je 24:6⟧, al.), ⟪to build up⟫ (AV, ⟪edify⟫): absol., ⟦Acts 20:32|Ac 20:32⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 8:1|I Co 8:1⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 10:23|10:23⟧; c. acc. pers., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:4|I Co 14:4⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:11|I Th 5:11⟧; pass., ⟦Acts 9:31|Ac 9:31⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:17|I Co 14:17⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:5|I Pe 2:5⟧; of blameworthy action (AV, embolden), ⟦1 Corinthians 8:10|I Co 8:10⟧ (cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-, συν-οικοδομέω).†

G3619.b:

(< οἶκος, + δέμω, to build), [in LXX: ⟦1 Chronicles 29:1|I Ch 29:1⟧ A (⁨בִּירָה⁩), ⟦Ezekiel 17:17|Ez 17:17⟧ ⟦Ezekiel 40:2|40:2⟧ (⁨בּנה⁩, ⁨מִבְנֶה⁩), Si 22:16 40:19, al.;] = cl. οἰκοδομία (q.v.), -δόμησις (Thuc., Plat.),
⟪1.⟫ the act of ⟪building⟫; in NT always metaph., ⟪building up⟫, ⟪edifying⟫: ⟦Romans 14:19|Ro 14:19⟧ ⟦Romans 15:2|15:2⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:26|I Co 14:26⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 10:8|II Co 10:8⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 13:10|13:10⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:29|Eph 4:29⟧; c. gen. obj., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:12|I Co 14:12⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 12:19|II Co 12:19⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:12|Eph 4:12⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:16|16⟧; λαλεῖν, λαβεῖν, οἰ., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:3|I Co 14:3⟧.
⟪2.⟫ = οἰκοδόμημα, ⟪a building⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:1|Mt 24:1⟧, ⟦Mark 13:1|Mk 13:1⟧, ⟦Mark 13:2|2⟧; metaph., ⟦1 Corinthians 3:9|I Co 3:9⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 5:1|II Co 5:1⟧, ⟦Ephesians 2:21|Eph 2:21⟧.†

G3620.b:

G3621.b:

⟪1.⟫ prop. (Plat., Arist.), ⟪the office of⟫ οἰκονόμος, ⟪stewardship⟫: ⟦Luke 16:2|Lk 16:2-4⟧.
⟪2.⟫ In later writers (Plut., al.; v. AR on ⟦Ephesians 1:10|Eph 1:10⟧; MM, xviii), generally, ⟪administration⟫, ⟪dispensation⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 9:17|I Co 9:17⟧, ⟦Ephesians 1:10|Eph 1:10⟧ ⟦Ephesians 3:2|3:2⟧, ⟦Ephesians 3:9|9⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:25|Col 1:25⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 1:4|I Ti 1:4⟧.†

G3623.b:
⟪οἰκονόμος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< οἶκος + νέμω, to manage), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨עַל־הַבַּיִת⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., ⟪the manager of a household⟫ or ⟪estate⟫, ⟪a house-⟫ or ⟪land-steward⟫ (usually a slave or freedman): ⟦Luke 12:42|Lk 12:42⟧ ⟦Luke 16:1|16:1⟧, ⟦Luke 16:3|3⟧, ⟦Luke 16:8|8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:2|I Co 4:2⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:2|Ga 4:2⟧; ὀ οἰ. τ. πόλεως (RV, treasurer; cf. I Es 4:49), ⟦Romans 16:23|Ro 16:23⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Metaph. (in wider sense; cf. οἰκονομία), ⟪an administrator⟫, ⟪a steward⟫: of Christian ministers, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:1|I Co 4:1⟧, ⟦Titus 1:7|Tit 1:7⟧; of Christians generally, ⟦1 Peter 4:10|I Pe 4:10⟧.†

G3624.b:
⟪οἶκος⟫, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨בַּיִת⁩, also for ⁨הֵיכָל⁩, ⁨אֹהֶל⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., ⟪a house⟫, ⟪dwelling⟫: ⟦Acts 2:2|Ac 2:2⟧ ⟦Acts 19:16|19:16⟧; c. gen. poss., ⟦Matthew 9:6|Mt 9:6⟧, ⟦Matthew 9:7|7⟧, ⟦Mark 2:11|Mk 2:11⟧, ⟦Luke 1:23|Lk 1:23⟧, al.; c. gen. attrib., ἐμπορίου, ⟦John 2:16|Jo 2:16⟧; προσευχῆς, ⟦Matthew 21:13|Mt 21:13⟧, al.; of a sanctuary (Hdt., Eur.): οἶ. τ. θεοῦ, of the tabernacle, ⟦Matthew 12:4|Mt 12:4⟧, al.; the temple, ⟦Matthew 21:13|Mt 21:13⟧, al.; metaph. of a city: ⟦Matthew 23:38|Mt 23:38⟧, ⟦Luke 13:35|Lk 13:35⟧; of the body, ⟦Matthew 12:44|Mt 12:44⟧, ⟦Luke 11:24|Lk 11:24⟧; of Christians, ⟦1 Peter 2:5|I Pe 2:5⟧; ἐν οἴ (M, Pr., 81 f.), ⟪at home⟫, ⟦Mark 2:1|Mk 2:1⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:34|I Co 11:34⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 14:35|14:35⟧; so κατ’ οἶκον, ⟦Acts 2:46|Ac 2:46⟧ ⟦Acts 5:42|5:42⟧; οἱ εἰς (= οἱ ἐν; v.s. εἰς) τ. οἶ., ⟦Luke 7:10|Lk 7:10⟧ ⟦Luke 15:6|15:6⟧; κατ’ οἴκους, ⟪from house to house⟫, ⟦Acts 8:3|Ac 8:3⟧ ⟦Acts 20:20|20:20⟧; εἰς (κατ’) οἶκον, c. gen. (Bl., § 46, 9), ⟦Mark 8:3|Mk 8:3⟧, ⟦Luke 14:1|Lk 14:1⟧, ⟦Romans 16:5|Ro 16:5⟧, al.
⟪2.⟫ By meton., ⟪a house⟫, ⟪household⟫, ⟪family⟫: ⟦Luke 10:5|Lk 10:5⟧, ⟦Acts 7:10|Ac 7:10⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:16|I Co 1:16⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 3:4|I Ti 3:4⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 3:5|5⟧ al.; of the Church, ὁ οἶ. τ. θεοῦ, ⟦1 Timothy 3:15|I Ti 3:15⟧, ⟦Hebrews 3:2|He 3:2⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:17|I Pe 4:17⟧; of descendants, οἶ Ἰσραήλ (Δαυείδ, Ἰακώβ; Bl, § 47, 9), ⟦Matthew 10:6|Mt 10:6⟧, ⟦Luke 1:27|Lk 1:27⟧, ⟦Luke 1:33|33⟧, al. (cf. ⟦Exodus 6:14|Ex 6:14⟧, ⟦1 Samuel 2:30|I Ki 2:30⟧, al.).
SYN.: v.s. οἰκία.

G3628.b:

G3630.b:
⟪οἰνο-πότης⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< οἶνος + πότης, a drinker), poët. and late prose, [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 23:20|Pr 23:20⟧ (⁨יַיִן⁩ ⁨סֹבֵא⁩)*;] ⟪a wine-drinker⟫, ⟪wine-bibber⟫: ⟦Matthew 11:19|Mt 11:19⟧, ⟦Luke 7:34|Lk 7:34⟧.†

G3631.b:
